name: Design & UX
description: Image-first work grid and case-study pages for product, UX and visual designers.
guidance: Only publish work you are allowed to show. Check your client and employer agreements, blur or replace confidential screens and data, and ask permission before naming a client or showing unreleased work.

heroSuggestions.title: Product Designer
heroSuggestions.summary: Product designer who turns complex problems into clear, usable interfaces, working across research, interaction design and prototyping with engineers and product teams.

seo.title: {name} — {title}
seo.description: {name}, {title}. Selected case studies, the process behind them and how to get in touch.
seo.aboutDescription: About {name}, {title}: background, approach and the teams and products worked on.

summary.hint: What you were responsible for and what changed because of your work.

title.hint: Name the project, for example the product and the part you redesigned.

role.hint: Your part, for example Lead designer.

org.label: Client or team
org.hint: Only name a client you have permission to name.

problem.label: The brief
problem.hint: What needed solving and for whom. Plain text.

approach.label: Process
approach.hint: What you did and why: research, ideas, testing. Plain text.

impact.label: Outcomes
impact.hint: One outcome per line, up to 8. Use figures you can stand behind.

heroImage.label: Cover image
heroImage.hint: Shown on the work grid and at the top of the case study. JPEG, PNG or WebP. Cropped to a 4:3 card.

screenshots.label: Case-study images
screenshots.hint: Add pictures one at a time on the Images page. Each needs a description for people who cannot see it.

links.label: Links
links.hint: Where to see more, such as a prototype or a film. Videos are linked, never embedded.

category.hint: A discipline such as Product design or Research. Used by the filter on the work page.

credentialUrl.label: Link to the award or course

url.label: Link to the recording or slides
url.hint: http or https. Recordings are linked, not embedded.

quote.label: What they said
quote.hint: Plain text. Only with the person's permission.

body.label: Article text
body.hint: Markdown. Raw HTML is shown as text, not run.

cover.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Shown at the top of the article and when it is shared.

heading.label: Home page introduction
heading.hint: The first thing visitors read, above your selected work. Plain text. Changes apply as soon as you save.

eyebrow.label: Role line
eyebrow.hint: For example your discipline and focus. Plain text.

heading.label: Key figures
heading.hint: Short facts such as years of practice or products shipped. Only publish figures you can stand behind. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: Pages of your site
heading.hint: Choose which pages the site has, what the menu calls them and in which order. Hiding a page never deletes it. Changes apply as soon as you save.

heading.label: About you
heading.hint: Your story, how you work and what you care about. Changes apply as soon as you save.

valueProps.label: Principles
valueProps.hint: Short statements about how you work, shown above the text.

heading.label: Back up and restore your portfolio
heading.hint: Keep your portfolio in one file, or restore one. You see what would change first, and nothing is ever removed.

exportHeading.label: Save a copy
exportHeading.hint: One file with your details and every entry, including unpublished ones. Pictures you uploaded are listed, not included.

importHeading.label: Restore from a file
importHeading.hint: Each entry in the file is matched to one of yours by its name or title: a match is updated, anything else is added.

home.workEmptyBody: Add the projects you are proudest of. Lead with a strong cover image, then tell the story behind it.
home.contactHeading: Have a product to shape? Let's talk.

projects.heading: Case studies
projects.lead: Selected projects: the brief, how I approached it and what changed.
projects.emptyBody: Add your first case study with a cover image and a few pictures of the work.
projects.noWriteup: The full story behind this project is on the way.

experience.heading: Where I've designed
experience.lead: Most recent first: the teams I have joined, what I owned and what we shipped.

skills.heading: How I work

skills.empty: No skills have been added yet.
